mapper.update: UPDATE zh_guarantee_info a JOIN ( SELECT customerid, customername, execnominalsum, usablenominalsum, suboccupynominalsum, startdate, expiredate, inputuserid FROM ( SELECT t.customerid, t.customername, t.execnominalsum, t.usablenominalsum, t.suboccupynominalsum, t.startdate, t.expiredate, t.inputuserid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY t.customerid ORDER BY t.creditno DESC ) AS rn FROM clms_ed_credit_info t WHERE substring( t.hive_sys_time, 1, 10 ) = #{ydate} AND REPLACE( t.expiredate, '/', '-' ) > #{ydate} AND t.credittype = '010010' AND t.customername LIKE '%担保%' ) x WHERE x.rn = 1 ) b ON a.client_name = b.customername SET a.client_num=b.customerid, a.client_name=b.customername , a.notional_amount=b.execnominalsum, a.occupy_notional_amount=b.usablenominalsum , a.occupy_exposure_amount=b.usablenominalsum , a.usablenominalsum=b.suboccupynominalsum, a.`start`=b.startdate , a.last_expire=b.expiredate, a.operator=b.inputuserid , a.create_time=NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zh_guarantee_info ( client_num, client_name, notional_amount, occupy_notional_amount, occupy_exposure_amount, usablenominalsum, `start`, last_expire, operator ) SELECT b.customerid, b.customername, b.execnominalsum, b.usablenominalsum, b.usablenominalsum, b.suboccupynominalsum, b.startdate, b.expiredate, b.inputuserid FROM ( SELECT customerid, customername, execnominalsum, usablenominalsum, suboccupynominalsum, startdate, expiredate, inputuserid FROM ( SELECT t.customerid, t.customername, t.execnominalsum, t.usablenominalsum, t.suboccupynominalsum, t.startdate, t.expiredate, t.inputuserid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY t.customerid ORDER BY t.creditno DESC ) AS rn FROM clms_ed_credit_info t WHERE substring( t.hive_sys_time, 1, 10 ) = #{ydate} AND REPLACE( t.expiredate, '/', '-' ) > #{ydate} AND t.credittype = '010010' AND t.customername LIKE '%担保%' ) x WHERE x.rn = 1 ) b WHERE b.customername NOT IN ( SELECT client_name FROM zh_guarantee_info WHERE client_name IS NOT NULL )

insert into ccms_business_contract (customerid,customername, exposurebalance,usableexposuresum, usablenominalsum,businesssum2,putoutdate,maturity,operateuserid) select customerid,customername, suboccupynominalsum , usablenominalsum ,usablenominalsum , execnominalsum ,startdate,expiredate,inputuserid from clms_ed_credit_info where substring( hive_sys_time ,1,10)= #{ydate} and credittype =000020
